items.exampleEn: If you make an effort, you will do better next time.
items.exampleZh: 如果你努力，下次會做得更好。

items.exampleEn: The students made money by selling cookies.
Many people in this village make a living from fishing.
items.exampleZh: 這個村子裡很多人靠捕魚謀生。

items.exampleEn: Nobody was paying attention to me at the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 開會時沒有人在注意我。

items.exampleEn: I put on weight during the winter vacation.
I like to spend time with my grandparents.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡花時間陪爺爺奶奶。

items.exampleEn: My little brother hates to take medicine.

items.sentenceEn: Pay attention to the time, or you'll miss the train.
items.sentenceZh: 注意一下時間，不然你會錯過火車。

items.audioEn: My uncle makes a living by fixing old bikes.
items.audioZh: 我叔叔靠修理舊腳踏車謀生。
items.questionZh: 說話者的叔叔靠什麼謀生？

items.sentenceEn: We spent time together at the night market last Saturday.
items.sentenceZh: 上星期六我們一起在夜市度過了一段時光。

items.sentenceEn: Our cat runs away when it is time to take medicine.
items.sentenceZh: 每到吃藥時間，我們的貓就會跑掉。

items.stemEn: My cat ____ after my brother gave her lots of snacks.
items.stemZh: 我的兄弟給我的貓很多零食之後，牠變胖了。

items.stemEn: He sells his old books online to ____.
items.stemZh: 他在網路上賣舊書來賺錢。

items.passageEn: Grandpa Wang is seventy, and he makes a living by selling rice and soup at the night market. He makes an effort to greet every customer by name. He doesn't make much money, but he loves his job. Every evening, his grandson helps him and pays attention to the prices. The boy also helps him count the money. The boy is saving up for a new bike. When the market is quiet, they spend time together talking about everything.
items.passageZh: 王爺爺七十歲了，他靠在夜市賣飯和湯謀生。他努力叫出每位客人的名字跟他們打招呼。他賺的錢不多，但他很愛這份工作。每天晚上，他的孫子都來幫忙，並且注意價錢。孫子也會幫他數錢。孫子正在存錢買新腳踏車。夜市人少的時候，祖孫倆就一起聊天，什麼都聊。

items.promptZh: 他今天上課時沒有注意聽老師說話。
referenceEn: He didn't pay attention to the teacher in class today.
In class today, he did not pay attention to the teacher.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 pay attention to the teacher 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 listen to the teacher 等）也算對
今天上課的事用過去式否定（例如 didn't pay attention to、didn't listen to 等）

items.promptZh: 我哥哥去年暑假在咖啡店打工賺錢。
referenceEn: Last summer, my brother made money by working at a coffee shop.
My brother worked at a coffee shop to make money last summer.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 made money、to make money 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 earned money、earned some money 等）也算對
去年暑假的事用過去式（例如 worked、made money 等）
「在咖啡店打工」可寫，例如 working at a coffee shop、had a job at a cafe 等
